verdict.rationale: Crossplane is an infrastructure control-plane, not an agent, so the axis of publishing an official MCP server for agents to connect via does apply (it's a platform/tool whose ecosystem could ship one), but no evidence in the pack mentions any MCP server, integration, or protocol support—only a marketing line about APIs being actionable by 'AI systems'. Missing for 10: any documented MCP server, endpoint, or first-party integration enabling agent connectivity.
